name: CSWA 11 (Hubble)
blurb: CSWA 11, a galaxy group acting as a gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: cswa11-hubble
story: The gravity of this group of galaxies bends the light of a far more distant galaxy into an arc around its central galaxy. Astronomers studied it in a search for fossil groups, where one massive galaxy has come to dominate its neighbors.

claims.text: CSWA 11 is the CASSOWARY lens SDSS J0800+0812, with a central lensing galaxy
Hubble target CSWA-11 is at RA 08 00 13.06, Dec +08 12 08.4, matching the archive pointing
The lensed galaxy appears as an arc and lies far behind the lens (source z = 1.408 vs lens z = 0.314)
CSWA 11 is a lensing galaxy group
The Hubble program searched for fossil group progenitors among CASSOWARY lenses
A fossil group is one where a massive brightest galaxy dominates
